name: A01_9_an_opponents_flier_entering_under_your_control_triggers_the_watcher
notes: Printed: 'Whenever another creature you control with flying enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.' The 'you control' is the controller of the creature as it enters, not its owner (CR 110.2, 603.6a). Liliana, Waker of the Dead's -7 emblem puts the OPPONENT's Mistral Singer (printed flying, owned by seat 1) from its graveyard onto the battlefield under seat 0's control at the beginning of combat: the Singer is seat 0's creature (controller lane 0) and the Watcher becomes 3/3.
